DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お乗りになる前に行き先を伺います。建物のお名前か住所はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you get in, may I ask your destination? Do you know the building's name or address?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 交流館へ行きたいです。集合案内を持っていますが、この名前だけで場所はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交流館の集合案内を持ち名前だけで行き先がわかるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to go to the community center. I have the meeting instructions; can you identify the place from this name alone?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have the community center's meeting instructions and ask whether its name alone identifies the destination. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じような名前の建物と取り違えたくないので、住所の欄も見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'd like to avoid confusing it with a similarly named building. Could you show me the address section too?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内の裏に住所があります。入口は川側と書いてありますが、どちらで降りるのかも迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 裏の住所を示し川側入口のどこで降りるか不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The address is on the back. It says the entrance is on the river side, but I'm also unsure where to get out.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the address on the back and explain that you do not know where to get out for the riverside entrance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この練習用の案内で場所を照合しましょう。車で近づける入口かは、案内の記載だけではまだ判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the location against these practice instructions. The information alone does not yet tell us whether a car can approach that entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 主催者に確認する連絡先が載っています。乗る前に、車で行ける入口を聞いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 掲載された連絡先で乗車前に車の入口を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are contact details for the organizer. May I ask which entrance is accessible by car before I get in?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to use the listed contact details to check the vehicle entrance before boarding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先に確かめていただいて構いません。確認の結果、離れた所で降りる場合に歩けるかも考えておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check first. Also consider whether you could walk if the answer means getting out some distance away.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物が重いので、入口まで長く歩くことは避けたいです。近くへ行けなければ荷物を減らして出直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物が重く長距離の徒歩を避け近くへ行けなければ荷物を減らすと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My luggage is heavy, so I'd like to avoid a long walk to the entrance. If you cannot get close, I'll reduce my luggage and come back.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your luggage is heavy, you want to avoid a long walk, and you will return with less luggage if the car cannot get close. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が済んだら、その条件も含めて行き先を伺います。まだ乗車せず、案内の住所と入口の説明をそろえましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've checked, I'll ask your destination including those conditions. Please do not get in yet; let's have both the address and the entrance details ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所と車で行ける入口を主催者に聞きます。近くで降りられると確認できてから乗車をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所と入口を確かめ近くで降りられるとわかってから乗ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask the organizer for the address and the entrance accessible by car. I'd like to get in only after confirming I can get out nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the address and entrance and get in after confirming you can get out nearby. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認の間はこちらでお待ちしています。それでは、返事がありましたら声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll wait here while you check. Please let me know when you have a reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切断の準備確認をします。まだ始動せず、作業票の寸法と表示を読み比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's check preparations for cutting. Do not start the machine yet; compare the dimensions on the work sheet with the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 作業票は三十センチですが、表示は三十二になっています。前の作業の設定が残っているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作業票の三十センチと表示の三十二の不一致を示し以前の設定か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The work sheet says thirty centimeters, but the display says thirty-two. Could the previous job's setting still be there?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the mismatch between thirty centimeters on the work sheet and thirty-two on the display and ask whether it is an earlier setting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残っているかは担当者に確かめます。表示を変えたり試しに動かしたりせず、そのまま待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the person in charge whether it remains from before. Wait without changing the display or running the machine to test it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表示には触りません。紙の束もまだ置かずに、別の台で待たせる方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示を変更しないと答え紙の束を別台に置いて待つか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't touch the display. Should I keep the stack of paper on another table rather than put it on the machine yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will not change the display and check whether to leave the stack of paper on another table while waiting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 束は準備台に置いたままにしましょう。違う寸法の束と混ざらないよう、作業票を添えておけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's leave the stack on the preparation table. Could you put the work sheet with it so it does not get mixed with stacks of other dimensions?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 準備台の束に作業票を添えます。ただ、隣の束には札がないので、どちらの作業分なのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の束に作業票を添え隣の無札の束の作業元が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put the work sheet with the stack on the preparation table. However, the stack beside it has no tag, so I don't know which job it belongs to.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will put the work sheet with your stack and explain that you do not know which job the neighboring untagged stack belongs to. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 札のない束についても確認します。自分の束とまとめず、場所の違いを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the untagged stack too. Do not combine it with yours; tell me where each is.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の束は台の手前で、札のない束は奥です。確認待ちの間、切断後の数量を書く用紙を用意してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手前と奥で束を区別し確認中に数量記録用紙を準備できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: My stack is at the front of the table, and the untagged one is at the back. While we wait for confirmation, may I prepare the form for recording quantities after cutting?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the stacks at the front and back, and ask whether you may prepare the quantity record form during the check. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 空の用紙を用意するところまでお願いします。実際に切っていない数量は記入しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please just prepare a blank form. Do not enter quantities that have not actually been cut.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 用紙だけ用意して数量は空欄にします。寸法の確認と束の区別が済むまで、切断は始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙だけ用意して数量を空欄にし寸法と束の確認まで切断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll prepare only the form and leave the quantity blank. I won't start cutting until the dimensions and the distinction between the stacks have been checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare only the form, leave the quantity blank, and not cut until the dimensions and stacks have been checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者を連れて戻ります。それでは、準備台で待っていてください。また読み合わせから続けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll return with the person in charge. Please wait at the preparation table. We'll resume by reading through the details together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座開設についてのご相談ですね。まず、口座をどのような目的でお使いになる予定か伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like advice about opening an account. First, may I ask what you plan to use the account for?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給料の受取りに使いたいです。勤務先の記入例と、私の書類にある名前の書き方が違うので困っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与受取り用で勤務先例と自分の書類の名前表記が違うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to receive my salary. I'm having trouble because the name in my employer's example is written differently from the name on my documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the account is for receiving salary and the name format in your employer's example differs from your documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 違いを見比べましょう。記入例では、どの部分が違っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the differences. Which part of the example is different?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務先の例は名前を短くしていますが、私の書類には長い名前が全部あります。短く書いて申込んでよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記入例の短い名前と書類の完全な名前を説明し省略して申込めるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The employer's example shortens the name, but my documents show my full long name. May I apply using an abbreviated name?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the shortened name in the example and the full name in your documents, and ask whether you may apply with an abbreviation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここで省略してよいとは決められません。この練習では、名義の扱いと開設の条件を担当者に確認してから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot decide here that abbreviation is acceptable. In this exercise, we fill it in after checking with the person in charge about account-holder names and account-opening requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、名前はまだ書きません。勤務先には、銀行で確認した表記を使えるか聞く必要もありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: まだ名前を記入せず銀行の確認表記を勤務先が使えるか聞く必要を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't write my name yet. I also need to ask my employer whether they can use the name format confirmed by the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not fill in your name yet and need to ask whether your employer can use the format confirmed by the bank. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 勤務先に提出する欄については、そちらにも確認しましょう。今お持ちの書類以外に何が必要かも、受付担当に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check with your employer about the fields submitted to them. We'll ask reception what else is needed besides the documents you have now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は相談だけにして、必要な書類を一覧で教えてもらえますか。足りない物をそろえてから来たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回は申込みをせず必要書類の一覧を求め不足をそろえて再訪したいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could I just have a consultation today and get a list of the required documents? I'd like to come back after gathering anything missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not apply this time, request a list of required documents, and say you want to return after obtaining the missing items. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者へその希望を伝えます。一覧を受け取ったら、どの書類が手元にあるか分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the person in charge that. When you receive the list, separate and check which documents you already have.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一覧で持っている物と不足している物を分けます。名義と勤務先への表記が確認できるまで申込みは進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一覧で書類を分け名義と勤務先表記の確認まで申込みを保留すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use the list to separate what I have from what is missing. I won't proceed with the application until the account-holder name and the name format for my employer are confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will sort the documents using the list and hold the application until the account name and employer's name format are confirmed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、受付担当へご案内します。確認事項がそろいましたら、また開設の相談にお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SUSAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take you to reception. Please come back to discuss opening the account once all the points have been confirmed.

DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: タオルの料金表をご覧ですね。ご持参の物についても伺ってよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the towel price list. May I also ask what you've brought?

DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: タオルは一枚もありません。この料金にある大きいタオルを買えば、そのまま持ち帰れるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: タオル未持参と伝え、料金表の大きいタオルは購入して持ち帰る物か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't brought any towels. If I buy the large towel listed here, can I take it home?
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have no towels with you and ask whether the large towel on the price list is for purchase and taking home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この欄は大きいタオルの貸出です。返却していただく物で、販売の小さいタオルとは別です。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: This section is for renting a large towel. It must be returned and is separate from the small towels for sale.

DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 貸出を購入と読み違えました。大きい物は借りて、小さい物は買う場合、会計で別々に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 貸出と販売を読み違えたと認め、大きい物の貸出と小さい物の購入を別会計項目で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I misread rental as purchase. If I rent a large one and buy a small one, I'd like to confirm them as separate items at checkout.
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge confusing rental with sale and say you want to check the large towel rental and small towel purchase as separate checkout items. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 貸出と販売を分けてお会計します。借りた物は受付横の返却口へお願いします。ほかに、入る前に確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll charge separately for rental and sale. Please return rented items to the return point beside reception. Is there anything else you want to check before going in?

DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待っている家族へ、着替えた後に電話しようと思っていました。脱衣所で自分だけを写す写真なら撮れますか。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 着替え後に家族へ電話するつもりだったと説明し、自分だけを写す写真なら脱衣所で撮れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was planning to call my family, who are waiting, after changing. May I take a photo in the changing room if only I appear in it?
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you planned to call your family after changing and ask whether a changing-room photo showing only you is allowed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの施設では脱衣所と浴室の撮影・通話はお断りしています。今、外の連絡できる場所でお済ませください。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: This facility does not allow photography or phone calls in the changing rooms or bathing area. Please take care of that now in the outside communication area.

DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分しか写らないつもりでも、脱衣所では撮らないのですね。入る前に外で連絡し、携帯電話をしまってから戻ります。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分だけのつもりでも脱衣所では撮らず、入る前に外で連絡して電話をしまうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I shouldn't take photos in the changing room even if I intend to photograph only myself. I'll contact them outside before entering, put my phone away, and come back.
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not take changing-room photos even of just yourself, and will contact your family outside before entering and put your phone away. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。受付の外にある連絡場所の表示をご覧ください。タオルのご用意は、その後になさいますか。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please see the sign for the communication area outside reception. Would you like to arrange the towels afterward?

DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に家族へ連絡します。戻ったら大きいタオルの貸出と小さいタオルの購入をお願いし、借りた物は返却口へ返します。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先に外で家族へ連絡し、戻って大小タオルを借用・購入し借用品は返却口へ返すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll contact my family first. When I return, I'd like to rent a large towel and buy a small one, and I'll return the rented one to the return point.
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to contact your family outside first, then return to rent the large towel and buy the small one, returning the rented towel to the return point. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を伺いました。まず外の表示の場所でご連絡ください。お戻りになってから、二つのタオルを分けてご案内します。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-KGS-IBUSUKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted your wishes. First, please contact them at the place indicated outside. When you return, we'll explain the two towels separately. See you shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご到着ありがとうございます。予約のお名前と、確認の画面を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Thank you for arriving. May I see the name on your reservation and the confirmation screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。一人で二泊するつもりで予約しましたが、概要に二名一泊とあるのが気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人二泊のつもりだが概要が二名一泊で気になると予約画面を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here they are. I intended to book two nights for one person, but I'm concerned that the summary says one night for two people.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show your reservation screen and say you intended one person for two nights but are concerned it says two people for one night. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの画面と受付の記録は、どちらも二名一泊です。ご希望はお一人で、明後日までの二泊ということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Both your screen and our reception record say two people for one night. Would you like two nights for yourself, until the day after tomorrow?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。二という数字だけを見て、泊数だと思っていました。もう一人が後で来る予定もありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二を泊数と思った誤りを説明し、一人で明後日まで二泊希望で同行者は来ないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I saw only the number two and thought it meant nights. There is no other person coming later either.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you mistook two for the number of nights, want two nights alone until the day after tomorrow, and no companion will arrive. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人数と泊数の変更として担当へ照会します。二泊目のお部屋と料金の確認が必要ですので、今の条件のまま泊まれるとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the person in charge about changing the guest count and number of nights. We need to check the second night's room and price, so I cannot promise you can stay under the current terms.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二泊目も同じ部屋とは限らないのですね。空きがある場合でも、二泊分の総額を聞いてから変更を頼みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二泊目の同室を前提にせず、空きがあっても総額を聞いてから変更を依頼したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the second night may not be in the same room. Even if there is availability, I'd like to hear the total for both nights before requesting the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you do not assume the same room for the second night and want the total before requesting a change even if space is available. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その条件を添えます。変更しない場合の今の予約の扱いも、料金と一緒に説明を受けてください。お荷物はまだお手元ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll include that condition. Please also have them explain what happens to your current reservation if you do not change it, along with the prices. You still have your luggage with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。予約が直ったと思って部屋へは行かず、ここで待ちます。二泊できなければ別の宿も探す必要があるので、回答前に次の移動は決めないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約修正済みと思って入室せず受付で待ち、二泊不可なら別の宿を探す必要もあるため回答前に移動を決めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't assume the reservation has been corrected and go to a room; I'll wait here. If I can't stay two nights, I'll need to look for another place, so I won't decide my next journey before the reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait at reception without assuming the booking is corrected and entering a room, and will not decide your next journey before the answer because you may need another lodging if two nights are unavailable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更希望の内容を紙にまとめました。一名二泊、同室かどうかと総額を確認してから判断する、という内容でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've written your requested change on paper. Is this right: one person for two nights, and you will decide after checking whether the room stays the same and the total price?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その内容でお願いします。受付記録がまだ二名一泊であることも控え、担当の回答後に変更するか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更希望の人数・泊数・同室と総額確認を認め、現予約は二名一泊のままと控え回答後に判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. I'll also note that the reception record still says two people for one night, and decide whether to change it after the person in charge replies.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the requested guest count, nights, same-room check and total, note the current booking remains two people for one night, and say you will decide after the reply. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望の紙を予約担当へ渡しました。現在の予約が自動で変わったわけではありませんので、こちらで回答をお待ちください。受付でのご相談は承りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've passed your request to the reservations staff. Your current booking has not changed automatically, so please wait here for the answer. We've received your request at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 畑へ出る前の空箱確認をお願いします。机の箱と担当票を見て、最初に質問したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check the empty boxes before going to the field. Look at the boxes on the desk and the assignment sheet. Is there anything you want to ask first?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 洗浄済みの札がある箱なら、そのまま収穫に使ってよいと思っていました。私の担当は札を数えるだけでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗浄済みなら使用可と思っていたと説明し、自分は札を数える担当なのか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought a box with a washed tag could be used for harvesting as it is. Is my job just to count the tags?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you thought a washed tag meant a box was ready to use and check whether your assignment is counting tags. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は、札の数ではなく箱の状態を見て気づいた点を報告する担当です。洗浄済みの札だけで破損がないとは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today your job is to inspect the condition of the boxes and report what you notice, rather than count tags. A washed tag alone does not establish that there is no damage.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この箱の角にひびのような線があります。私が使えると決めず、どの箱か伝えて確認してもらうのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 角のひびのような線を伝え、自己判断で使用可にせず箱を特定して確認を頼む必要を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a line that looks like a crack on this box's corner. I should identify the box and ask for a check rather than decide myself it is usable, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report the crack-like line on the corner and confirm you need to identify the box and request a check without deciding yourself it is usable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのとおりです。箱の番号と見える状態を確認用紙に残してください。ひびに見える部分を直したり、荷物を入れて試したりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Record the box number and its visible condition on the inspection form. Do not repair the part that looks cracked or test it by putting things inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三番の角に線がある、と書きます。ほかの箱と重ねてしまうとわからなくなるので、置く場所を先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三番の角に線ありと記録し、重ねて紛れないよう確認待ち箱の置場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write that number three has a line on its corner. Please tell me where to put it first, so it doesn't get lost among other boxes if they are stacked together.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Record a line on number three's corner and ask where to put boxes awaiting inspection so it is not mixed into a stack. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この机の「確認待ち」の表示がある場所を使ってください。作業台の外へ運ぶ担当ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use the area marked “Awaiting inspection” on this desk. Your assignment does not include carrying boxes away from the worktable.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認待ちの場所へ分け、畑まで運ばないようにします。近くの補修用具を使って直すことも、今日の担当には含まれませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認待ちの場所へ分け畑まで運ばず、補修用具で直す仕事も含まれないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll separate it into the awaiting-inspection area and not carry it to the field. Repairing it with the nearby repair tools isn't part of today's assignment either, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you will separate it into the awaiting-inspection area, not carry it to the field, and that repair using the tools is not included. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回は状態の確認と報告までです。補修や使用可否の判断は担当責任者へ回します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: This time your work ends with checking and reporting the condition. Repairs and decisions on usability go to the responsible supervisor.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三番は確認待ち、角に線ありと記入しました。使用できる箱の数に勝手に入れず、責任者の判断が戻るまで分けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三番は確認待ちと記入し、使用可能数へ自己判断で加えず責任者の回答まで分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written “Number three: awaiting inspection; line on corner.” I won't count it among usable boxes on my own and will keep it separate until the supervisor's decision comes back.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you recorded number three as awaiting inspection and will keep it separate until the supervisor replies, without adding it to the usable count yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認用紙を受け取り、三番の場所も確認しました。責任者へ引き継ぎます。準備の点検はここで区切ります。お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received the inspection form and checked where number three is. I'll hand this over to the supervisor. We'll finish the preparation check here. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 旅行用品をお探しでしょうか。こちらのケースについて何かご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for travel supplies? Do you have a question about this case?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今使っている歯ブラシを持って出かけたいです。この細長い箱はケースだけですか。それとも歯ブラシも入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手持ち歯ブラシを持ち歩きたいと伝え、細長い商品はケースのみか中身付きか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take my current toothbrush on a trip. Is this long narrow box just a case, or does it include a toothbrush?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to carry your own toothbrush and ask whether the long narrow product is only a case or includes contents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらはケース単品です。隣の組には歯ブラシと小さい歯磨き剤が入っています。今の物をそのまま使いたいご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a case sold on its own. The set beside it contains a toothbrush and small toothpaste. Would you like to keep using your current one?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。まだ使えるので買い足したくありません。ただ、家の歯ブラシが太めで、このケースに入るか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ使える歯ブラシは買い足さず使いたいが太めなのでケースへ入るか心配だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It's still usable, so I don't want to buy another. But my toothbrush at home is rather thick, and I'm worried it won't fit in this case.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to use your still-usable toothbrush rather than buy another, but worry its thickness may prevent it fitting in the case. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外側の長さだけでは中に入るとは限りません。こちらに内寸の案内がありますので、歯ブラシの長さと幅を照合できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The outside length alone does not guarantee it will fit inside. Here are the internal dimensions; you can compare your toothbrush's length and width.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は歯ブラシを持っていないので、合うと言い切れませんね。包装を開けずに寸法を控えて、家で測ってから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歯ブラシ未持参で適合不明のため包装を開けず内寸を控え、自宅計測後に選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't have my toothbrush with me, so I can't be certain it fits. I'd like to note the dimensions without opening the packaging and choose after measuring it at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you cannot confirm the fit without your toothbrush, and want to note the internal dimensions without opening the package and choose after measuring at home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 寸法はこちらです。ケースだけを買う場合と、中身入りを買う場合では価格も異なりますので、それぞれの札をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are the dimensions. The case alone and the set with contents also have different prices, so please look at their separate labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 安いほうを選ぶより、今の歯ブラシが入る物を探します。持ち物を増やしたくないので、中身入りは今日は買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 安さより適合を優先し持ち物を増やしたくないので中身入りは買わないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look for something that fits my current toothbrush rather than just choose the cheaper one. I don't want more belongings, so I won't buy the set with contents today.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to prioritize fit over low price and not buy the set with contents because you do not want more belongings. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、単品の寸法と価格をメモしておきますか。入るか未確認のまま買う必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to note the dimensions and price of the case alone, then? You don't need to buy it before knowing whether it fits.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その二つを控えます。家で長さと幅を測り、内寸と比べてから単品を買うか決めます。今日はどちらも見送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単品の内寸と価格を控え、自宅で長さ・幅を比べてから購入判断し今日は両方見送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note those two things. I'll measure the length and width at home, compare them with the internal dimensions, and then decide whether to buy the case alone. I'll leave both options today.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will note the case's internal dimensions and price, decide after comparing the length and width at home, and buy neither today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 寸法の表示はこちらです。ご自宅で確かめて、合うか迷う点が残ればまたお尋ねください。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the dimensions display. Please check at home, and ask us again if you still have doubts about the fit. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの食品をお探しですか。冷蔵の棚にも似た名前の物がありますが、どちらをお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for this food? There is something with a similar name on the refrigerated shelf too. Which are you considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: どちらも同じ名前なので、期限が先の冷凍品を選ぼうと思いました。買った後は冷蔵庫に入れれば、その日付までよいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同名なら期限が遠い冷凍品を選び、冷蔵庫でも同日まで保存できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: They have the same name, so I was going to choose the frozen one with the later date. If I put it in the refrigerator after buying it, will it keep until that date?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you chose the frozen product with the later date because the names match, and ask whether it can keep in the refrigerator until the same date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この日付は、表示の保存条件と一緒に読む必要があります。こちらには冷凍で保存と書かれていて、冷蔵に変えても同じ日付までとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This date must be read together with the stated storage conditions. This says to keep it frozen; we cannot say it lasts until the same date if you switch to refrigeration.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 期限だけ比べていました。冷蔵と冷凍では条件が違うのですね。原材料も同じとは限らないので、両方の欄を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 期限だけ比べていたと認め、保存条件と原材料を冷蔵品・冷凍品それぞれで読みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was comparing only the dates. Refrigerated and frozen products have different conditions. The ingredients may not be identical either, so I'd like to read both ingredient lists.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge comparing only the dates and say you want to read each refrigerated and frozen product's storage conditions and ingredients. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 原材料はそれぞれ裏面です。使い方や保存の案内も別々にお読みください。購入後はすぐご自宅へお帰りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Each ingredient list is on the back. Please read their usage and storage instructions separately too. Will you be going straight home after buying it?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この後に用事が二つあり、すぐには帰りません。保冷の用意もないので、冷凍品を今かごに入れるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰宅前に用事が二つあり保冷準備もないため、今は冷凍品をかごに入れないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have two errands afterward and won't go home immediately. I haven't prepared anything to keep it cold either, so I won't put the frozen item in my basket now.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide not to put the frozen item in your basket now because you have two errands before going home and no way prepared to keep it cold. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだお買い上げ前ですので、こちらで冷凍の棚へ戻します。持ち帰りに必要な準備と、ご帰宅の予定を踏まえてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You haven't purchased it yet, so I'll return it to the frozen shelf. Please choose with the preparations for taking it home and your return schedule in mind.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰る直前にもう一度見ます。家の冷凍庫に空きがあるかも確認してからにしたいです。冷蔵品へ変えれば何も考えなくてよい、とは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰る直前に見直し冷凍庫の空きも確認し、冷蔵品へ変えるだけで条件確認が不要とは考えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look again just before going home. I'd also like to check whether there is space in my freezer first. I won't assume switching to the refrigerated product means there is nothing to consider.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will reconsider just before going home, check freezer space, and not assume switching to a refrigerated product removes the need to check conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 冷蔵品もその表示と持ち帰りの条件を確認する必要があります。今日は商品名と表示で確かめたい項目を控えておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You also need to check the refrigerated product's label and the conditions for taking it home. Would you like to note the product name and what to check on its label today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前と、原材料、保存条件、帰宅までの準備を控えます。今日は先に用事を済ませ、どちらにするかは持ち帰れる条件を確かめてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品名・原材料・保存・持帰り準備を控え、用事後に持帰り可能な条件を確認してから商品を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the name, ingredients, storage conditions, and preparations for the journey home. I'll finish my errands first today and decide which to buy after checking that I can take it home under the required conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will note the name, ingredients, storage and transport preparations, and choose after your errands once you have checked the conditions for taking it home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 冷凍品は棚へお戻ししました。条件が整理できてから、またお声がけください。お買い物の続きもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've returned the frozen item to the shelf. Please ask again once you have sorted out the conditions. Take care as you continue shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 明日の田作業について、集合の連絡を読み合わせます。どこへ行く指示だと読みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's read through the meeting instructions for tomorrow's rice-field work. Where did you understand you should go?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 天気が晴れなら、前に聞いた田んぼへ直接行くのだと思いました。連絡には別のことが書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 晴れなら以前の田へ直行すると思っていたと述べ、集合連絡には別の指示があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought that if it was sunny, I should go straight to the rice field I was told about before. Do these instructions say something different?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought you should go directly to the previous field if sunny, and ask whether the meeting message has different instructions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この文には「現地へ向かう前に担当へ連絡」とあります。晴れの予報を見ただけで、その連絡を省くとは読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This says, “Contact the person in charge before heading to the site.” A sunny forecast alone does not mean you may omit that contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 晴れるかどうかと、集合の指示は別ですね。しかも私の画面の予報は昨日の更新でした。新しい連絡を優先して確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 晴天予報と集合指示を分け、予報は昨日更新だったため新しい連絡の日時を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The sunny forecast and the meeting instructions are separate things. And the forecast on my screen was updated yesterday. I'd like to prioritize the new message and check its date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the sunny forecast from meeting instructions and say you want to check the new message's date and time because the forecast was updated yesterday. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、どの日時の連絡かを確かめましょう。この紙は明日の予定についてです。ただし、最終の集合場所は担当への確認が必要と書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, let's check the date and time of the message. This paper concerns tomorrow's plans. However, it says the final meeting place must be confirmed with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前と同じ田んぼとは決めず、「明日の集合場所はどこですか」と聞きます。返事がなければ、前の道を通って探しに行ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前回と同じ田と決めず明日の集合場所を聞き、未返信なら前の道から探してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume it is the same rice field as before; I'll ask where tomorrow's meeting place is. If there is no reply, may I take the previous route and look for it?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume the previous field; ask tomorrow's meeting place and whether you may search along the previous route if there is no reply. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返事を待たずに現地を探して歩くのではなく、連絡方法を担当責任者に確認してください。機械の通る道や水路の位置も、紙だけで判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Instead of walking around looking for the site without waiting for a reply, ask the responsible supervisor how to make contact. Do not judge where machinery routes or irrigation channels are from the paper alone either.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 現地へ出る前に、返答がないときの連絡先を聞きます。田んぼへ近道を探しに入らず、集合場所がわかるまで移動を始めない、という理解でよいかも担当に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 移動前に不通時の連絡先を聞き、田へ近道を探しに入らず集合場所不明なら出発しないと確認文にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before going to the site, I'll ask whom to contact if I get no reply. I'll also ask the person in charge whether I understand correctly that I shouldn't enter fields seeking shortcuts or start traveling until I know the meeting place.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Form a confirmation asking whom to contact if there is no response before traveling, and whether you should avoid entering fields for shortcuts and not depart while the meeting place is unknown. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認文を作りましょう。持参する物も、前回と同じと決めつけず、今回の担当から案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's write that confirmation. Do not assume the items to bring are the same as last time either; get instructions from the person responsible this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 集合場所、連絡がつかない場合の相手、今回の持参物の三つを書きました。この紙で担当に確認し、古い予報だけで出発しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 集合場所・不通時の相手・今回の持参物を三点で書き、担当返答を確認し古い予報だけで出発しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written three points: the meeting place, whom to contact if I can't reach them, and what to bring this time. I'll check these with the person in charge using this paper and avoid setting off based only on an old forecast.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you wrote the meeting place, alternative contact and current required items as three points, will check the reply, and will not leave based only on an old forecast. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三点の確認文ができました。教室ではここまでにして、現地へ向かう前に担当の返答をお確かめください。読み合わせ、お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your three-point confirmation is ready. We'll finish here in class; please check the person's reply before heading to the site. Thank you for reading through it together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花苗の梱包準備を始める前に、お二人に配った見本を並べてください。何か違いがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before preparing to pack the flower seedlings, please put the samples given to you both side by side. Are there any differences?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の紙は赤い札の見本ですが、同行の人の紙は白い札です。同じ箱を二人で用意するので、どちらへ合わせるのか困っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の赤札見本と同行者の白札見本が異なり、同じ箱を準備する二人がどちらへ合わせるか困っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My sheet shows a red tag, but my companion's shows a white tag. We're preparing the same box together, so we're unsure which one to follow.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your red-tag sample differs from your companion's white-tag sample and you are unsure which to follow when preparing the same box together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず紙の版と日付を比べましょう。赤い札の見本は前回分、白い札の見本は今回分と書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: First compare the sheets' versions and dates. The red-tag sample says it is from the previous round, and the white-tag sample says it is for this round.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤い見本は前回のでしたね。ただ、現物の箱には赤い札が付いています。今回の見本へ合わせて、私が白い札へ貼り替えるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 赤見本が前回分と理解しつつ現物も赤札なので、今回の白札へ自分で貼替えてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the red sample was for the previous round. But the actual box also has a red tag. Should I replace it myself with a white tag to match the current sample?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the red sample is old, but say the actual box also has a red tag and ask whether you should replace it yourself with the current white tag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見本の違いに気づいたことは報告してください。現物の札を自己判断で剥がしたり貼り替えたりはしません。箱の番号を記録しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Report that you noticed the samples differ. Do not remove or replace the actual tag on your own judgment. Let's record the box number.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五番の箱に赤い札、と書きます。私は箱の照合で、同行の人は見本の版を確認する、と分けて報告してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五番箱の赤札を記録し、自分は箱照合、同行者は見本版確認と分けて報告してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write “Box five: red tag.” May we divide the report so I check the box and my companion checks the sample version?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Record the red tag on box five and ask whether you can report separately on your box comparison and your companion's sample-version check. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二つを整理して、二人とも同じ記録を確認してください。作業の続行や札の変更は、責任者の説明があるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Organize those two points and both check the same record. Wait for the supervisor's explanation before continuing work or changing tags.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人で「五番の赤い札と今回の白い見本が不一致」と確認します。見本が新しいから現物が誤り、とまでは決めつけないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人で五番と今回見本の不一致を確認し、新しい見本だから現物が誤りと断定しないと確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll both confirm that box five's red tag does not match this round's white sample. We shouldn't conclude the actual box is wrong just because the sample is newer, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Both confirm the mismatch between box five and the current sample, and check that a newer sample alone does not prove the actual box is wrong. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不一致の原因は、責任者に内容を見てもらって判断します。前回の紙は今回分と混ざらないよう分けておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The supervisor will examine the details to determine the reason for the mismatch. Keep the previous round's sheet separate so it does not get mixed with the current one.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 前回分を別にし、二人の確認結果を一枚にまとめました。五番を出荷済みの所へ動かさず、札をそのままにして記録を渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 前回紙を分け二人の記録を一枚にまとめ、五番を出荷済みへ動かさず札を保持して渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've separated the old sheet and put both our findings on one page. I won't move box five to the shipped area; I'll keep its tag as it is and hand over the record.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you separated the old sheet, combined both findings on one page, and will hand over the record without moving box five to the shipped area or altering its tag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 五番と見本の不一致を受け取りました。前回の紙も分けられていますね。責任者への確認に回しますので、梱包の開始はいったんお待ちください。お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received the mismatch report for box five and the sample. The old sheet is separate too. I'll refer this to the supervisor, so please wait before starting to pack. Thank you for your work.
